newsitem.title: UK: BT calls off fight over windfall tax-paper.
newsitem.headline: BT calls off fight over windfall tax-paper.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc called off its fight with the Labour government after determining that the windfall tax will cost the company only 500 million stg, the Times said on Thursday.
The paper said the company - which had feared it would have to pay one billion stg - was officially reviewing its legal position.
However, the Times said that BT officials had made it clear that challenging the tax in European courts was unlikely.

The Times quoted BT chairman Iain Vallance saying, "BT is disappointed to have been caught up in the windfall levy ... Nevertheless, we recognise that a figure in the order of 500 million stg spread over two years, while not a small sum, is considerably lower than earlier speculation might have suggested." --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
